summary: Jin Shu 53’s owned chronology is mostly supported once Western years are taken from Hui of Western Jin’s era sequence rather than from conventional reign-year labels alone. 惠帝即位 and the tutor list are AD 290; 元康元年 moves and companion-sons are AD 291; 九年六月 remains AD 299; the 十二月 deposition is already AD 300 because Yuankang 9 month 12 begins 8 January 300 and 壬戌 is the day before 永康元年正月癸亥朔. Yongkang 1 months 1–6 (Xuchang, the murder, the burial) stay AD 300; 永寧元年正月/八月 are AD 301; 太安元年三月癸卯 is AD 302 because Jin Shu applies that year-count to the whole 壬戌 year, whose third month begins 14 April 302. Sui ages are kept and not turned into a birth year. Three defects remain: AD 291 was attached to fathers named only in the 息-formula of s0205; s0131’s executions of Liu Zhen, Sun Lü, and Cheng Ju were omitted as deaths; and Xiao Ji’s hint ‘legendary antiquity’ is not a source-dated life event.
